query: INSERT INTO `validator-demo-project.validator_backup.transactions_snapshots` (snapshot_at, document_id, document_name, last_modified, operation, data, event_id) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS snapshot_at, document_id, document_name, timestamp AS last_modified, operation, SAFE.PARSE_JSON(data) AS data, event_id FROM `validator-demo-project.validator.transactions_raw_latest` WHERE operation != "DELETE"
